entries.title: Ask HN: Is all of FAANG like this?
entries.author: faang0722
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Is all of FAANG like this?
entries.excerpt: This last year I finally landed a SDE job at a FAANG company! However, I'm considering quitting because I am not happy. The good: I get paid better than my last jobs. I can browse internal resources to satisfy my curiosity about how things work. The bad: Basically no work gets done and there's no motivation to do any. The dev tools, docs and tech debt impart such a slow iteration speed that even when I am working a full 8 hours, only a few very small changes get done, yet som
entries.guide_zh: 如愿加入大厂后仍不快乐，发帖者想知道其他 FAANG 公司是否也一样。

entries.excerpt: Hey everyone, I’m Vlad and I co-founded QuestDB ( https://questdb.io ) with Nic and Tanc. QuestDB is an open source database for time series, events, and analytical workloads with a primary focus on performance ( https://github.com/questdb/questdb ). It started in 2012 when an energy trading company hired me to rebuild their real-time vessel tracking system.
